words.zh: 是； 有，存在； 做，成为； 发生
words.ex_en: Don’t disturb me while I’m working.
words.ex_zh: 我工作的时候不要打扰我。

words.ex_en: He’s gone to get some fish and chips.
words.ex_zh: 他去买炸鱼薯条了。

words.ex_en: the back of the house
words.ex_zh: 房子的后部

words.zh: 按照（表示方式）；从事于；在…之内
words.ex_en: There’s some sugar in the cupboard.
words.ex_zh: 碗橱里有一些糖。

words.zh: 有； 进行， 从事； 享受， 经受； 使， 让； 必须， 不得不
words.ex_en: Our guests have arrived.
words.ex_zh: 我们的客人到了。

words.zh: [指无生命的东西、动物、植物]它；这；那
words.ex_en: ‘Where’s your office?’ ‘It’s on the third floor.’
words.ex_zh: “你的办公室在哪儿？”“在三楼。”

words.ex_en: He deliberated with them over that question.
words.ex_zh: 他和他们商量了那个问题。

words.zh: 为，为了；因为；给；对于；至于；适合于
words.ex_en: I’ve got a present for you.
words.ex_zh: 我有件礼物送给你。

words.ex_en: Hi, Kelly. How are you?
words.ex_zh: 嗨，凯利，你好吗？

words.ex_en: ‘Where’s Paul?’ ‘He’s gone to the cinema.’
words.ex_zh: “保罗在哪儿？”“他去看电影了。”

words.ex_en: I saw Bob in town with his girlfriend.
words.ex_zh: 我看到鲍勃与他的女朋友一起在镇上。

words.zh: 向前地；作用中，行动中；继续着
words.ex_en: I wanted to punch him on the nose.
words.ex_zh: 我真想一拳打到他鼻子上。

words.zh: [did-done] 做， 从事； 实行， 进行； 尽力； 可用； 制作； 算出， 解答
words.ex_en: ‘Will Kay come?’ ‘She may do.’
words.ex_zh: “凯来吗？” “或许吧。”

words.ex_en: ‘I’m so tired,’ she said.
words.ex_zh: “我太累了。”她说。

words.zh: 在（表示存在或出现的地点、场所、位置、空间）；以（某种价格、速度等）；向；达；因为；朝；忙于
words.ex_en: I met my wife at a disco.
words.ex_zh: 我在迪斯科舞会上认识了我的妻子。

words.ex_en: It’s an old car, but it’s very reliable.
words.ex_zh: 这是一辆旧车，但是性能非常可靠。

words.zh: 我们（主格）；笔者，本人（作者或演讲人使用）；朕，寡人
words.ex_en: ‘Did you go into the supermarket?’ ‘No, we didn’t.’
words.ex_zh: “你们进超级市场了吗？”“我们没有进去。”

words.ex_en: That should be his mother.
words.ex_zh: 那大概是他的母亲。

words.ex_en: Most of the stores do not open until 10 am.
words.ex_zh: 大多数商店要到上午10点才开始营业。

words.zh: 通过；被；依据；经由；在附近；在……之前
words.ex_en: I was attacked by a dog.
words.ex_zh: 我被一条狗袭击。

words.zh: 她（主格）；它（用来指雌性动物或国家、船舶、地球、月亮等）
words.ex_en: You could always ask Beth – she’s got plenty of money.
words.ex_zh: 你总是可以去问贝丝——她有很多钱。

words.ex_en: Shall we go out to the cinema or stay at home?
words.ex_zh: 我们是出去看电影还是待在家里？

words.zh: 因为；随着；虽然；依照；当…时
words.ex_en: I saw Peter as I was getting off the bus.
words.ex_zh: 我下公共汽车的时候看见了彼得。

words.ex_en: What are you doing?
words.ex_zh: 你在做什么？

words.ex_en: They talked her round to their position.
words.ex_zh: 他们说服她同意他们的看法。

words.ex_en: Here they are – I can see their car.
words.ex_zh: 他们来了——我看到他们的汽车了。

words.zh: [got-gotten/got] 获得， 弄到； 收到； 变得； 拿来； 理解， 听到； 到达
words.ex_en: She got loads of presents.
words.ex_zh: 她收到了许多礼物。

words.zh: （表条件）如果；即使；是否；（表假设）假如
words.ex_en: We’ll stay at home if it rains.
words.ex_zh: 如果下雨，我们就待在家里。

words.zh: 她（she的宾格）；她的（she的所有格）；她（指某个国家；一艘船）
words.ex_en: Jane? I don’t really know her.
words.ex_zh: 简？我不太认识她。

words.ex_en: You shouldn’t be sitting here by yourself, all alone.
words.ex_zh: 你不应该一个人孤零零地坐在这儿。

words.ex_en: All my friends do not smoke.
words.ex_zh: 我的朋友并不全都吸烟。

words.ex_en: a book about politics
words.ex_zh: 一本有关政治的书

words.zh: 将，会，要〔用于构成将来时〕
words.ex_en: A meeting will be held next Tuesday at 3 p.m.
words.ex_zh: 下星期二下午3点将召开一个会议。

words.ex_en: We walked slowly up the hill.
words.ex_zh: 我们慢慢地爬上山。

words.ex_en: ‘Have you got a camera?’ ‘No.’ ‘You should buy one’ (= buy a camera ).
words.ex_zh: “你有照相机吗？”“没有。”“你应该买一架。”

words.zh: 时间；时代；次数；节拍；倍数
words.ex_en: Einstein changed the way we think about space and time.
words.ex_zh: 爱因斯坦改变了我们的时空概念。

words.ex_en: The troops will not advance until ordered to do so .
words.ex_zh: 在接到命令之前，部队不会前进。

words.ex_en: Has anyone seen my keys? I can’t find them anywhere.
words.ex_zh: 有人见到我的钥匙吗？我哪儿都找不到。

words.zh: 一些；某个；大约；相当多的
words.ex_en: I’ve just made a pot of coffee. Would you like some?
words.ex_zh: 我刚煮了一壶咖啡，你想喝点吗？

words.ex_en: Stop, you’re hurting me.
words.ex_zh: 住手，你弄疼我了。

words.zh: [took-taken] 带， 携带； 需要， 花费； 拿， 取得； 接受； 吃， 喝， 服(药
words.ex_en: Would you mind taking Susie home ?
words.ex_zh: 请你带苏茜回家好吗？

words.zh: 出现；在外；出局；出声地；不流行地
words.ex_en: Many of the homeless have been sleeping out for years.
words.ex_zh: 许多无家可归者常年露宿街头。

words.zh: 到…里；深入…之中；成为…状况；进入到…之内
words.ex_en: Come into the office.
words.ex_zh: 到办公室里来。

words.zh: 只是，仅仅；刚才，刚刚；正好，恰好；实在；刚要
words.ex_en: A good strong cup of coffee is just what I need right now.
words.ex_zh: 我现在正需要喝一杯浓浓的咖啡。

words.ex_en: Are you in love with him?
words.ex_zh: 你爱上他了吗？

words.ex_en: You should keep in with your colleagues.
words.ex_zh: 你应当与你的同事友好相处。

words.ex_en: I could do it, he mused.
words.ex_zh: 我能做这件事，他沉思着。

words.ex_en: She's a widow now.
words.ex_zh: 她现在是一个寡妇。

words.ex_en: I like your jacket.
words.ex_zh: 我喜欢你这件上衣。

words.ex_en: They were just like any other young couple.
words.ex_zh: 他们那时就和其他任何年轻夫妇一样。

words.ex_en: How do you spell your name?
words.ex_zh: 你的名字怎么拼写？

words.ex_en: He emphasized its importance to me.
words.ex_zh: 他向我强调它的重要性。

words.ex_en: They partook of our triumph.
words.ex_zh: 他们分享我们的胜利。

words.ex_en: I’d like you to line up in twos, please.
words.ex_zh: 请你们两个一组排好队。

words.ex_en: You’ll have to be more careful next time.
words.ex_zh: 你下次要更小心一点。

words.ex_en: I really want a drink.
words.ex_zh: 我很想喝一杯。

words.zh: 方法；道路；方向；行业；习惯
words.ex_en: There are several different ways we can tackle this problem.
words.ex_zh: 我们可以用几种不同的方法处理这个问题。

words.zh: 看；期待；注意；面向；看上去像
words.ex_en: We sneaked out while Jessie’s mom wasn’t looking.
words.ex_zh: 我们趁杰茜的妈妈没有看到，偷偷地溜了出去。

words.ex_en: I’ll join you in a minute but I need to make a phone call first.
words.ex_zh: 我一会儿就来，但是我得先打个电话。

words.zh: 新的，新鲜的；更新的；初见的
words.ex_en: the city’s new hospital
words.ex_zh: 市里新建的医院

words.ex_en: ‘Are you Italian?’ ‘No, I’m Spanish.’
words.ex_zh: “你是意大利人吗？”“不，我是西班牙人。”

words.ex_en: There were two men and a woman in the car.
words.ex_zh: 车上有两男一女。

words.zh: 发现，找到 〔一直在寻找之物〕
words.ex_en: I can’t find the car keys.
words.ex_zh: 我找不到汽车钥匙。

words.ex_en: What are you doing here?
words.ex_zh: 你们在这里干什么？

words.ex_en: People say things they don’t mean when they are angry.
words.ex_zh: 人生气时就会口不择言。

words.zh: [gave-given] 给予， 赠送； 供给， 提供； 做出， 发出
words.ex_en: Researchers were given a £10,000 grant to continue their work.
words.ex_zh: 研究人员得到一万英镑的经费以继续他们的研究。

words.zh: 好； 妥善地， 有利地； 令人满意地； 完全地； 充分地， 足够地； 很， 相当
words.ex_en: Did you sleep well?
words.ex_zh: 你睡得好吗？

words.ex_en: Naomi was only 17 when she got married.
words.ex_zh: 娜奥米结婚时才17岁。

words.zh: [told-told] 讲， 告诉； 吩咐， 命令； 说明， 显示； 分辨， 区分
words.ex_en: I’ll tell you all about it when I get back.
words.ex_zh: 我回来再告诉你这一切。

words.zh: [数] 偶数的；平坦的；相等的
words.ex_en: The floor must be completely even before we lay the tiles.
words.ex_zh: 地面必须完全平整后才能铺地砖。

words.zh: 后面；背部；靠背；足球等的后卫；书报等的末尾
words.ex_en: a T-shirt with a picture of a snake on the back
words.ex_zh: 后背印了一条蛇的T恤衫

words.ex_en: We should be prepared for any contingency.
words.ex_zh: 我们应该对任何应急情况有所准备。

words.ex_en: She smiled at him as he walked through the door.
words.ex_zh: 他从门口进来时，她朝他笑了。

words.ex_en: Please help us.
words.ex_zh: 请帮助我们。

words.ex_en: The hotel is ideal for families with young children.
words.ex_zh: 这家宾馆对带小孩的家庭再合适不过。

words.ex_en: David bent down to tie his shoelace.
words.ex_zh: 戴维弯腰系鞋带。

words.zh: 可以，能够；可能，也许；祝，愿；会，能
words.ex_en: I may be late, so don’t wait for me.
words.ex_zh: 我可能会迟到，所以别等我。

words.ex_en: Tomorrow. Or the day after.
words.ex_zh: 明天。或者后天。

words.ex_en: What should I do? Should I trust him?
words.ex_zh: 我该怎么办？我应该相信他吗？

words.ex_en: I heard someone calling in the distance.
words.ex_zh: 我听到远处有人在叫。

words.ex_en: You really should come over and see our new house.
words.ex_zh: 你真的该过来看看我们的新房子。

words.ex_en: I still haven’t finished painting the spare room.
words.ex_zh: 我还没粉刷完那间空房间。

words.zh: 试图，努力；试验；审判；考验
words.ex_en: Let’s have a rest and then we’ll try again.
words.ex_zh: 我们休息一下，然后再试。

words.zh: 末尾，最后；上个；鞋楦（做鞋的模型）
words.ex_en: I didn’t read the last chapter of the book.
words.ex_zh: 我没有看这本书的最后一章。

words.zh: 需要，要求；缺乏；必要之物
words.ex_en: She works to provide for her family’s basic needs.
words.ex_zh: 她工作是为了维持家里的基本生计。

words.ex_en: Do you still feel hungry?
words.ex_zh: 你还觉得饿吗？

words.ex_en: They’ve won their last three games.
words.ex_zh: 他们赢了最近三场比赛。

words.ex_en: She was in an extremely confused state of mind .
words.ex_zh: 她思绪纷乱。

words.ex_en: He supplements his regular meals by eating between meals.
words.ex_zh: 他在两餐之间吃点东西来补充正餐。

words.zh: 高的；高级的；崇高的；高音调的
words.ex_en: This is the highest mountain in Japan.
words.ex_zh: 这是日本最高的山。

words.ex_en: She’s one of the most experienced teachers in the district.
words.ex_zh: 她是该地区最有经验的教师之一。

words.zh: 又一，另一；另外的；不同的
words.ex_en: Can you cite another case like this one?
words.ex_zh: 你能举出另一个像这样的例子吗?

words.zh: [put-put, putting] 放， 摆， 使处于； 说， 表达； 提出， 提交； 记下，
words.ex_en: So it was an accident, an ‘act of God’ if you want to put it like that .
words.ex_zh: 那么这是个意外，是 上帝的作为”，如果你想那么说的话。

words.ex_en: They arrived while we were having dinner.
words.ex_zh: 他们来时我们正在吃饭。

words.zh: [meant-meant] 表示…的意思； 意欲， 打算； 意指， 意味着
words.ex_en: What does ‘patronizing’ mean?
words.ex_zh: patronizing是什么意思？

words.zh: [kept-kept] 使保持， 使继续； 阻止， 防止； 履行， 遵守； 保存， 保
words.ex_en: You can keep it. I don’t need it any more.
words.ex_zh: 你留着吧，我不需要了。

words.ex_en: Warren's eldest son is an art student.
words.ex_zh: 沃伦的长子是一名学艺术的学生。

words.ex_en: Why, look who’s here!
words.ex_zh: 哎呀，看看这是谁！

words.zh: [let-let]　允许， 让； 假设； 出租； 排放
words.ex_en: I can’t come out tonight – my dad won’t let me.
words.ex_zh: 今天晚上我不能出来，我爸爸不允许。

words.zh: 相同的；同一的；上述的（通常与the连用）；无变化的
words.ex_en: Her perfume has always had the same effect on me.
words.ex_zh: 她身上的香水给我的感觉一如既往。

words.ex_en: a big house
words.ex_zh: 大房子

words.ex_en: A group of us are going to London.
words.ex_zh: 我们有一群人要去伦敦。

words.ex_en: As everybody’s here, let’s begin.
words.ex_zh: 大家都到齐了，我们就开始吧。

words.ex_en: Ann didn’t seem very sure.
words.ex_zh: 安看来并不十分肯定。

words.ex_en: I could hear Sarah and Andy talking in the next room.
words.ex_zh: 我听到萨拉和安迪在隔壁讲话。

words.ex_en: Where are you going?
words.ex_zh: 你要到哪儿去？

words.zh: 转动，使旋转；转弯；翻过来；兑换
words.ex_en: Ricky turned and walked away.
words.ex_zh: 里基转身走了。

words.ex_en: His every utterance will be scrutinized.
words.ex_zh: 他说的每句话都会被细查。

words.ex_en: There’s so much to do. I don’t know where to start.
words.ex_zh: 有那么多的事情要做，我都不知道从哪里开始。

words.ex_en: Steve gripped the steering wheel tightly with both hands.
words.ex_zh: 史蒂夫双手紧握方向盘。

words.ex_en: The man grinned, showing bad teeth.
words.ex_zh: 那男人咧着嘴笑，露出一口坏牙。

words.zh: 部分；角色；零件；一些；片段
words.ex_en: For part of the day, you will be outside doing practical work.
words.ex_zh: 你们每天将有一部分时间在户外实际操作。

words.ex_en: How dared they do such a thing?
words.ex_zh: 他们怎么敢做出这样的事?

words.zh: 又，此外；再一次；再说；增加
words.ex_en: Can you say that again? I didn’t hear.
words.ex_zh: 你能再说一遍吗？ 我没听见。

words.zh: 事例， 实例； 情况， 事实； 病例； 案件； 箱， 盒； 手提箱
words.ex_en: Tom’s career is a case in point (= a clear example of something that you are discussing or explaining ) .
words.ex_zh: 汤姆的事业就是个明证。

words.ex_en: They reviewed each aspect of the plan bit by bit.
words.ex_zh: 他们对计划的各个方面逐一地进行了审核。

words.ex_en: Yes, that’s the right answer .
words.ex_zh: 对，回答正确。

words.zh: 节目单； 节目， 表演， 演出； 计划， 方案； 程序
words.ex_en: a word processing program
words.ex_zh: 文字处理程序

words.ex_en: Can I ask you a question?
words.ex_zh: 我能问你个问题吗？

words.zh: 游戏；扮演；演奏；播放；同…比赛
words.ex_en: He’s learning to play the piano.
words.ex_zh: 他在学习弹钢琴。

words.ex_en: The Government are planning further cuts in public spending.
words.ex_zh: 政府正计划进一步削减公共支出。

words.zh: [run-run, running] 跑， 奔跑； 行驶， 驾驶； 蔓延， 伸展； 操作； 竞
words.ex_en: The road runs along a valley.
words.ex_zh: 这条路沿山谷延伸。

words.zh: 数；（杂志等的）期；号码；数字；算术
words.ex_en: They wrote various numbers on a large sheet of paper.
words.ex_zh: 他们在一张大纸上写下了很多不同的数字。

words.ex_en: How are you off for sports equipment? (= do you have enough? )
words.ex_zh: 你的体育运动装备够不够？

words.ex_en: Good gymnasts rehearse their moves mentally before a competition.
words.ex_zh: 优秀的体操运动员赛前都会在心中默默地把动作过一遍。

words.ex_en: It was a cold moonlit night.
words.ex_zh: 那是个寒冷的月夜。

words.zh: 活的；生动的；实况转播的；精力充沛的
words.ex_en: experiments on live animals
words.ex_zh: 动物活体实验

words.zh: 要点；得分；标点；[机] 尖端
words.ex_en: That’s a very interesting point.
words.ex_zh: 那个观点很有趣。

words.zh: [held-held] 拿， 握； 使保持某种状态；
words.ex_en: Lift your head off the floor and hold this position for five seconds.
words.ex_zh: 把头抬离地面，保持这个姿势五秒钟。

words.ex_en: I couldn’t go shopping yesterday so I’ll have to go today.
words.ex_zh: 我昨天没能去买东西，所以今天我必须去。

words.zh: [brought-brought] 带来， 拿来； 把…引来； 促使， 使发生
words.ex_en: The discovery of gold brought thousands of people to the Transvaal.
words.ex_zh: 黄金的发现把成千上万的人引到了德兰士瓦。

words.ex_en: When I next saw her she completely ignored me.
words.ex_zh: 我再次见到她时，她压根儿没有理我。

words.ex_en: After the storm we were without electricity for five days.
words.ex_zh: 暴风雨之后我们断电了五天。

words.ex_en: The new road should be completed before the end of the year.
words.ex_zh: 这条新公路应该在年底前完工。

words.zh: 必须，一定；可以，应当；很可能
words.ex_en: Warm clothes are a must in the mountains.
words.ex_zh: 御寒衣物在山里是必不可少的。

words.ex_en: These toys are not suitable for children under five.
words.ex_zh: 这些玩具不适合五岁以下的儿童玩。

words.zh: 房间；空间；余地；机会；房间里所有的人
words.ex_en: I looked around the room.
words.ex_zh: 我四下看了看房间。

words.ex_en: Only cheeses made in this area may be labelled ‘Roquefort.’
words.ex_zh: 只有这个地区出产的干酪才能被称作“罗克福尔干酪”。

words.zh: 国家的；国民的；民族的；国立的
